heard: Ahithophel the Jelanite left his home To counsel the king who wore the crown His words were weighed like the word of God Esteemed by both David and Absalom When the rebellion grew strong and deep He joined the side of the rebellious heir David fled on foot with his people Praying for the Lord to break the scheme Turn Ahithophel's counsel into folly Let the good advice be frustrated For the Lord has ordained the outcome And the plans of the wicked are scattered
